Author: Arzhael
Name: AutoStanceXIV
Description:
Keeps your tank stance in the state you choose (on or off) on every tank: Paladin/Gladiator, Warrior/Marauder, Dark Knight and Gunbreaker.
Apply it always, or only at specific moments: zone change, resurrection, job change, countdown, pull (bosses only), duty recommence after a wipe.
Classic mode uses the same settings everywhere; advanced mode has separate settings for the open world, dungeons, trials, raids and alliance raids.
Available in English and French. Command: /autostance
Punchline: Automatically turns your tank stance on or off.
